concerns.text: US-2's independent test requires verifying that k_est 'correlates linearly with the ground-truth friction coefficient across a sweep of multiple randomized trials', but no FR or SC covers estimator validation against ground truth. FR-001 only defines computation; SC-002 only measures downstream success rate. Add an FR/SC for the correlation-validation experiment or the story's core testable claim is unbacked.

FR-007 anchors to '(See Edge Cases)' rather than a user story. Its scope (clamping k_est for numerical stability) plainly serves US-2's estimator, so re-anchor it to US-2 (and/or US-1 via FR-002's reward scaling) for clean traceability.
